model_family: Three Gaussian latent dependence structures with positive exponential projection to supplied finite-cohort arithmetic sample means and SDs

evidence_use.operator: arithmetic means and sample SDs on complete endpoint pairs
evidence_use.population: 12 adult men aged 35-55 with abdominal overweight/obesity; fasting measurements before/after 3 days at approximately 50% usual energy intake; no control arm.
evidence_use.measurement: Units specified per endpoint; serum leptin is raw ng/mL, not a log transformation
evidence_use.reason: Use all eight rounded raw-scale arithmetic means and sample SDs as finite-cohort construction constraints. These target-derived A0 marginal inputs do not validate the reconstructed changes, paired uncertainty, covariance or correlations; their sampling and rounding uncertainty is unavailable.

evidence_use.population: 12 adult men aged 35-55 with abdominal overweight/obesity; fasting measurements before/after 3 days at approximately 50% usual energy intake; no control arm.
evidence_use.reason: Use one synthetic person key, paired pre/post columns, the endpoint units and 12 complete endpoint pairs. Scale complete-pair counts by n/12 and round for general n. All raw measurements remain positive. No demographic records, control arm or causal finding is invented.

components.name: paired_layout_and_scaled_counts
components.source_to_target_assumptions: Same-population A0 rehearsal. Preserve packet endpoint order and paired missingness; every endpoint is complete at n=12. Any scaled missing pairs are selected exchangeably within endpoint, a software generalization rather than observed evidence. Keys are newly synthetic.

components.name: positive_marginal_conditioning
components.source_to_target_assumptions: Retain the parent exponential projection: solve a shape parameter to reproduce each sample coefficient of variation, then rescale to its arithmetic mean. This permits positive skew and exact moments but conditions each realized cohort and therefore is not unconditional iid sampling. n=0 returns empty columns; one observed person receives the mean because sample SD is undefined. Exact constraints require sd/mean < sqrt(observed count), as holds for this packet for every count >=2.

components.name: persistence_assumptions
components.source_to_target_assumptions: High persistence uses latent correlations 0.98 for body mass and 0.80 for the biochemical endpoints. Reduced persistence uses 0.90 for body mass and 0.40 for the biochemical endpoints. Greater body-mass stability is an explicit modeling judgment about stable individual size, not joint evidence. Lower persistence represents more transient person-level variation; neither parameter set is estimated.

components.name: shared_response_assumption
components.source_to_target_assumptions: Under shared_response, retain high persistence and set each endpoint innovation to sqrt(0.75)*U_person + sqrt(0.25)*epsilon_person_endpoint. The same standard-normal U is shared positively across endpoints, representing aligned individual deviations in response. All baseline endpoint scores remain independent. The 0.75 shared innovation variance fraction is an illustrative assumption, not a measured response correlation. Positive semidefiniteness follows from the explicit factor construction; raw and change correlations after projection are induced and not fixed.

scenarios.assumption: Parent high-persistence model: body_mass latent pre/post correlation 0.98; leptin, glucose and triglycerides 0.80; independent endpoint processes.
scenarios.inclusion_rationale: Retain the parent as one explicit stable-person hypothesis compatible with all source constraints. Source feedback reports valid marginal/count/support checks but supplies no evidence favoring its dependence assumptions. Retaining it anchors comparison with a changed persistence assumption and a changed response-coupling assumption.
